SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 3541
Date 6 / 5 / 32

May 6 32.

Sir,

I have the honour to refer to your letter
No.1164 dated April 20, 1932, and to state that
no trace can be found of one J. MacLeman in Shanghai.
"Philipi Street" does not exist and there is no
thoroughfare in Shanghai, the pronunciation of whose
name bears a resemblance to the word "Philipi".

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Officer i/c Special Branch.

Consul-General for the Netherlands,
Shanghai.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别股登记处。
编号 D 3541
日期 32年5月6日

1932年5月6日。

先生：

谨复阁下1932年4月20日第1164号来函，并告知，在上海查无名为 J. MacLeman 者之踪迹。“Philipi Street”并不存在，上海亦无任何街道名称的发音与“Philipi”一词相似。

此致
敬礼

您的顺从仆人，

特别股主管警官。

荷兰驻上海总领事，
上海。

REPORT
Special SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
Date May 5, 1932.
No. D 3541.
Date 6. 5. 32.

Subject (in full)........................................Attached letter ref. J. MacLean.

Made by................D.S. Moore................Forwarded by [Signature]

Regarding the attached letter from the Netherlands
Consulate-General seeking information concerning the whereabouts
of one J. MacLean and stating that he is supposed to reside
at "Philipi Street, Shanghai". Enquiries made in an effort
to locate MacLean have proved abortive. There is no street
in Shanghai bearing the name "Philipi Street", neither have
we been able to locate any street with a purely Chinese name,
the sounds of the characters of which bear any resemblance to
the word "Philipi".

W.S. Moore
D.S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

Mr Yan. Please draft reply.
[Initials]
6.5.32

关于荷兰总领事馆随函查询一名 J. MacLean 之下落，并称其据称居住于“上海 Philipi Street”。为查找 MacLean 所作之调查均告失败。上海并无名为“Philipi Street”之街道，吾等亦未能找到任何纯中文名称之街道，其汉字读音与“Philipi”一词有任何相似之处。

W.S. Moore

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. 49. HOLLANDIA.

No. 1164.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C & S. B. REGISTRY
No. D 7941
Date 21 / 4 / 32

SHANGHAI, 20 th April 1932.

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that I am en-
deavouring to find a certain Mr. J. Mac Leman, who is
supposed to live at Philipi street, Shanghai.

I am well aware that no street, bearing above
name, exists in Shanghai, but the possibility remains
that the name has been wrongly rendered into Latin script.
Perhaps you could be able to assist me in tracing
the person referred to above.

I have the honour to be,

Sir.

Your obedient servant,

（签名）

（批：No record
in C.&S.B.
Registry.
21.4.32 H.T.）

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别股登记处
编号 D 7941
日期 32年4月21日

上海，1932年4月20日。

先生：

谨通知阁下，本人正设法寻找一位 J. Mac Leman 先生，据称其居住于上海 Philipi street。

本人深知上海并无以此命名的街道，但仍有可能该名称在转写为拉丁字母时出现错误。或许阁下能协助本人追踪上述人士。

此致
敬礼

先生。

您的顺从仆人，

（签名）

（批注：刑事与特别股登记处无记录。
32年4月21日 H.T.）
